Ken (CS Ops): Heads-up — mid-cycle spend spike on Acadia: embeddings usage +48% in last 24h. Need QBR-ready runway forecast and a short remediation plan. @Liam can you surface commit/credits status? @Maya can you prep enablement notes we can drop into the deck?
Liam (Finance): On it. Quick read: committed credits cover ~36 days at current runrate, ~22 days if spike continues. Will post a small forecast table in a minute.
Maya (CS): Flagged with the customer. They ran a larger backfill batch yesterday. Drafting a scaled-batch recommendation + prompt/prefix caching checklist now.
Arjun (AE): FYI — customer has a marketing push early next week which explains the burst. Reached out to confirm exact timing.
Sofia (Acct): Confirmed from the customer side — campaign goes live Tue morning. They want near-real-time embeddings for personalization, but can tolerate staggered background jobs if we suggest it.
Ken (CS Ops): Proposed actions: 1) Liam — add forecast snippet, 2) Maya — enablement ops steps, 3) Arjun — confirm campaign ETA and acceptable degradation, 4) Ken — propose short-term throttle + cache policy. Please add to QBR deck under "runway & mitigation". :+1:
Liam (Finance): Forecast snippet (quick paste):
```
scenario,days_left
current,36
spike,22
with_throttle_and_cache,45
```
Maya (CS): Uploading enablement checklist to drive (internal link). Key ops steps: enable prefix caching for recurring keys, schedule non-urgent batch jobs off-peak, reduce batch_size for live requests. I'll paste the checklist after upload.
Ken (CS Ops): Need 2-3 slide bullets for the QBR. Draft: 1) Root cause: campaign-driven batch embeddings; 2) Mitigation: prefix caching + job scheduling + temporary throttle; 3) Runway: +23 days projected with mitigations. Thoughts?
Arjun (AE): I'll ask the customer what jobs can be deprioritized. If they allow throttling for non-critical flows we can avoid over-committing credits.
BudgetAlertBot: ALERT: Acadia monthly credit usage crossed 80% threshold at 2026-04-07T14:12Z — auto-notification sent to billing team.
Ken (CS Ops): Thanks everyone — I'll open a short runbook task and assemble the QBR slide. 30-min huddle in 30 to align before deck deadline? :calendar:
